subject: Capacity lock, burst credit and monthly floor agreement
messages:
From: Hannah Ellis <hannah.ellis@alpharetail.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ops@alpharetail.com, procurement@alpharetail.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity reservation for Q3 — monthly floor & burst credits

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency and cost profiles looked promising. We ran an internal sizing pass and want to lock predictable capacity for Q3 (July–Sept) to support a nationwide campaign. A few asks from our side: 

- Monthly committed token floor: want to set a guaranteed minimum we can rely on for forecasting.
- Burst credits: allowance for short-term spikes without throttling during campaign windows.
- Rate tiers and overage pricing: need clarity on how overage charges apply once the burst pool is exhausted.

I've attached a usage export for May so you can see our current shape (usage_export_May2027.csv). Can you propose a simple reserve structure we can evaluate with procurement? If possible, include invoice cadence and whether the first month is prorated.

Would prefer a short call tomorrow afternoon if that helps.

Thanks,
Hannah Ellis
Head of Platform Ops | AlphaRetail
Hannah.Ellis@alpharetail.com
+1 415-555-0134

Attachments: usage_export_May2027.csv (CSV, 82KB)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Hannah Ellis <hannah.ellis@alpharetail.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity reservation for Q3 — monthly floor & burst credits

Hi Hannah — thanks for the usage file, that helps a lot. High-level proposal below (we can turn into a 1-page SOW):

Proposal (Q3 reserve):
- Committed monthly floor: 18M tokens / month (billed monthly at committed rate)
- Burst credit pool: 9M tokens per month (consumable above floor, billed at burst rate until pool exhausted)
- Overage: After burst pool is used, overage billed at standard on-demand rate with a 10% step-up from committed rate
- Minimum term: 3 months (Jul–Sep) with a 30-day review at the end of August to re-balance if actuals diverge
- Auto-fallback: if regional capacity constrained, requests route to compatible model variant at the same rate band (no additional charge for transparent routing)
- SLA / latency target: 95th percentile < 220ms for <512 tokens (we'll include in SOW)

Billing & cadence: billed monthly in arrears. First invoice will be prorated based on activation date if the contract starts mid-month. We can also offer an optional upfront discount for quarterly prepay (2.5% for quarterly prepay).

Next steps: I've attached a short SOW draft (redwood_sow_draft_v2.docx). If procurement is comfortable with the structure, we can send a DocuSign envelope and lock the capacity.

If that looks good, let's do a 20-min sync today at 3pm PT — I'll send a calendar invite.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer

Looping in a couple of quick guardrails from our side — noted in-line.

On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 11:30 AM karthik_iyer@redwood.com wrote:
> Proposal (Q3 reserve):
> - Committed monthly floor: 18M tokens / month (billed monthly at committed rate)
> - Burst credit pool: 9M tokens per month (consumable above floor, billed at burst rate until pool exhausted)
> - Overage: After burst pool is used, overage billed at standard on-demand rate with a 10% step-up from committed rate
> - Minimum term: 3 months (Jul–Sep) with a 30-day review at the end of August to re-balance if actuals diverge
> - Auto-fallback: if regional capacity constrained, requests route to compatible model variant at the same rate band (no additional charge for transparent routing)

Suggested edits:
- Add explicit burst throttle threshold (we propose soft-throttle at 120% of monthly floor sustained for >30m) so operations know when to expect degraded throughput.
- Confirm data handling: AlphaRetail audit logs will be retained for 90 days by default; if you need extended retention we should note that as a separate line item.

I'll defer invoicing / legal language to finance/procurement, but happy to sign off once they confirm the small edits above.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Thanks — quick finance check. A couple of items we need to lock before we send DocuSign: 

1) Prorate / activation: Please confirm the expected activation date. If the start date is after Jul 1 we will prorate July on the first invoice.
2) Billing cadence: monthly in arrears (standard) — if AlphaRetail prefers quarterly prepay we can accept but need a separate invoice schedule (see attached invoice_schedule.xlsx).
3) Discount & approval: The 2.5% quarterly prepay discount is OK as a one-off; anything deeper requires Sales Ops approval.
4) Accounting contact & PO: procurement@alpharetail.com — we need a purchase order number to attach to invoices.

For bookkeeping, please confirm deal_id = ALPHA-2027-Q3-RESERVE-001 and whether the 3-month minimum term is acceptable. After procurement returns PO we'll queue for DocuSign.

-Marissa
